text_block_list.text:
The race ends amid thunderous
applause, and
Симболи Рудольф and
Марузенски congratulate one
another on
a battle well fought.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Reawakened to the thrill of racing,
Symboli
Rudolf pledges to share her joy
with every
Umamusume.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Later, at the press conference, she
outlines her
dream as Emperor to the
world. In this moment,
the Emperor is
truly born.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
